decision.observation: Zoomed view: the built brown ladder ends around y=0.30, and between its foot and the platform surface (y≈0.46) the cells are solid brown rock, not air. Ashkan and Gossmann stand on the platform directly below this rock column at x≈0.60-0.64. Dig tool is active.
decision.hypothesis: The ladder foot is 'unreachable' because solid rock separates it from the platform; digging the rock directly above the duplicants (adjacent, hence reachable) will open a route to the ladder foot so the column connects.
decision.memory: Build-in-air errors at the gap were because those cells are solid terrain, not occupied buildings.
